pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Rocks is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Rocks.
   B. Say Rocks never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Rocks as rumours only.
   D. Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Folding is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Folding.
   B. Say Folding never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Folding as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Introduction to Geography is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to Geography.
   B. Say Introduction to Geography never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Introduction to Geography as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Agriculture.
   B. Say Agriculture never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Agriculture as rumours only.
   D. Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. Which statement about Energy is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Energy as rumours only.
   B. Say Energy never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Energy.

8. Which statement about Earthquakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Earthquakes as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Earthquakes.
   C. Say Earthquakes never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Mining is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Mining.
   C. Say Mining never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Mining as rumours only.

10. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

12. Which statement about Industry is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Industry as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Industry.
   C. Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Industry never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Folding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Vulcanicity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Earthquakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Agriculture and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. D — Explain symbols used on a map

2. D — Explain Rocks with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. A — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain Folding with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. C — Explain Introduction to Geography with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. D — Explain Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. C — Explain Energy with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. D — Explain Earthquakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A — Explain Mining with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. B — Obeying laws and caring for public property

11. A — Plan income and spending wisely

12. C — Explain Industry with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Earthquakes; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Agriculture; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
